class.name: WorldStand
class.brief_description: The stand-age contract: years since the last stand-replacing disturbance over the ground.
class.description: Kept by the contract itself ([method WorldContracts.get_stand]): fire from [WorldFire], windthrow and beetle kills from the disturbances the trees add. Vegetation and trees read it for succession. Readers that cache it follow [signal stand_changed] or [method get_stand_changes_since]. See docs/ideas/world-contracts.md, Stand.

method.name: _browse_at
method.description: Override to answer [method browse_at] from a script (a test stub).

method.name: _browse_reach_at
method.description: Override to answer [method browse_reach_at] from a script (a test stub).

method.name: _disturbance_at
method.description: Override in a stub to replace [method disturbance_at].

method.name: _rooting_age_at
method.description: Override to answer [method rooting_age_at] from a script (a test stub).

method.name: _stand_age_at
method.description: Override in a stub to replace [method stand_age_at].

method.name: _strike_age_at
method.description: Override to answer [method strike_age_at] from a script (a test stub).

method.name: _trail_at
method.description: Override to answer [method trail_at] from a script (a test stub).

method.name: add_browse
method.description: Deer browse a disc (xz) at [param pressure] (0 to 1) up to [param reach_m] metres (red deer 1.8, fallow 1.6, roe 1.1). Returns its id. Reports its area through [signal stand_changed].

method.name: add_disturbance
method.description: A stand-replacing disturbance over a disc around [param center] (world XZ) of [param radius] metres, [param age_years] years ago, of [param kind] ([enum Disturbance]; windthrow and beetle kills, which the trees report; fire comes from [WorldFire]). Returns its id. Reports its area through [signal stand_changed].

method.name: add_disturbances
method.description: Adds a disc of [param radius] at each of [param centers], all of one [param kind] and age, with one grid rebuild and one [signal stand_changed] report (an avalanche track, a windthrow). Earlier events of the same kind that a new disc covers are replaced, so a path struck again keeps one event per disc. Returns the number added.

method.name: add_strike
method.description: Records a lightning strike into a tree crown at [param position] (the attachment point), [param age_years] ago. [WeatherLightning3D] records its canopy strikes here when [member WeatherLightning3D.record_tree_strikes] is on. At most 4096 are kept; the oldest go first. Reports its area through [signal stand_changed].

method.name: advance_years
method.description: The world's years pass: every disturbance added here ages by [param years] and its area is reported. Fire ages through its own producers.

method.name: browse_at
method.description: The browsing pressure at [param position] (0 to 1): the strongest disc's, eased out over each disc's outer 20 %, [code]0[/code] where none.

method.name: browse_reach_at
method.description: How high the browsing reaches at [param position] (m): the reach of the disc that gives [method browse_at], [code]0[/code] where none.

method.name: clear_browse
method.description: Removes every browse disc.

method.name: clear_disturbances
method.description: Removes every disturbance added with [method add_disturbance] and reports their area.

method.name: clear_strikes
method.description: Removes every recorded strike.

method.name: disturbance_at
method.description: The kind of disturbance behind [method stand_age_at] at [param position] ([enum Disturbance]); [constant DISTURBANCE_NONE] where none.

method.name: get_stand_changes_since
method.description: The areas reported after [param generation], for scripts and tests: [code]{"complete": bool, "area": Rect2}[/code]. [code]complete[/code] is [code]false[/code] when the log no longer reaches back that far (read everything again).

method.name: get_stand_generation
method.description: Increases with every reported change. Readers keep the generation they last read and ask [method get_stand_changes_since].

method.name: get_strike_count
method.description: The number of recorded strikes.

method.name: get_trails
method.description: The worn-path network last given to [method set_trails].

method.name: notify_stand_changed
method.description: Reports that [method stand_age_at] changed over [param area] (world XZ): bumps the generation, logs the area and emits [signal stand_changed]. Fire's burn changes are forwarded here.

method.name: remove_browse
method.description: Removes the browse disc [param id].

method.name: remove_disturbance
method.description: Removes the disturbance [param id] and reports its area.

method.name: rooting_age_at
method.description: Years (fractional) since the youngest boar rooting ([constant DISTURBANCE_ROOTING] disc) over [param position], [code]-1[/code] where none. Rooting turns the field layer, not the stand: [method stand_age_at] and [method disturbance_at] leave it out.

method.name: set_browse
method.description: Sets the browse disc [param id]'s pressure (0 to 1).

method.name: set_disturbance_age
method.description: Sets how many years ago the disturbance [param id] happened and reports its area.

method.name: set_trails
method.description: Publishes the worn-path network (game trails): Dictionaries with [code]"points"[/code] ([PackedVector3Array] or [PackedVector2Array], world x, z), [code]"width"[/code] (m), [code]"passes"[/code] (per year; or [code]"passes_per_year"[/code]) and [code]"kind"[/code]. Replaces the last network and reports the old and new areas through [signal stand_changed].

method.name: stand_age_at
method.description: Years since the last stand-replacing disturbance at [param position]: the youngest of a fire from [method WorldFire.burn_age_at] (unless [method WorldFire.crown_scorch_at] says only a surface fire passed, under 5 m) and the wind and beetle kills added here. -1 where none is known (old growth).

method.name: strike_age_at
method.description: Years since the youngest strike within 3 m (xz) of a tree trunk at [param position], or [code]-1[/code] where none. Fields pick a struck tree's variant by it (as [method stand_age_at] picks succession stages).

method.name: trail_at
method.description: The busiest trail over [param position]: x its passes per year, y its tread share (1 over the middle half of its width, easing to 0 at the edge); [code]Vector2(0, 0)[/code] off every trail. Ground detail, mud, snow and grass read the same lines.

signal.name: stand_changed
signal.description: The stand age changed over [param area] (world XZ).

constants.constant: A bark beetle kill. New kinds are only appended.
A beaver pond drained: the age is the years since it drained (a beaver meadow).
Boar rooting turned the soil: the age is the fractional years since. A field-layer disturbance, read by [method rooting_age_at]; [method stand_age_at] and [method disturbance_at] leave it out.
A dense avalanche broke the stand (SnowAvalanche3D [code]stand_damage[/code]): the age is the years since.
Freezing rain loaded the crowns past breaking (TreeGenerator's ice storm stand): broken tops and limbs, bent birch, the canopy opened but standing. The age is the years since.
